# Vitaly — Product Designer

> Personal website of Vitaly, a product designer based in Krasnodar, Russia.

## About
Product designer with experience in fintech, SaaS, and AI products. 
Passionate about the intersection of design and artificial intelligence.

## Sections
- Portfolio: Design and AI pet-projects with detailed case studies
- Blog: Posts (Telegram-style short notes) and Articles (long-form content)
- CV: Experience, education, skills, and certificates

## Contact
- Telegram: @nafanyah
- Website languages: Russian (primary), English

## Technical
- Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Content managed via custom CMS
- Bilingual: Russian and English
